no-restricted-syntax.message: Don't call the API with raw fetch(). Use the typed `apiClient` from '@/lib/api' (generated from openapi/openapi.yaml) so requests/responses are typed and covered by the OpenAPI no-drift check. If an endpoint is missing, add it to the spec and run `task openapi:gen`. The only sanctioned raw fetch is the external presigned upload in hooks/useImageUpload.ts.
